title: Soara and the House of Monsters
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Soara, an orphan raised by knights to fight the monsters attacking their kingdom, comes of age just as peace is declared. Looking for a new purpose, she meets Krik, a dwarf who leads the Monster Architects, and instead of fighting monsters she helps build homes for them while travelling.
life_message: Peace turns old enemies into neighbours, and everyone deserves a home.

content.note: Swordplay and action (AniList); mostly construction work (blurb).
